title: Shared definitions for the section 17 objects

currency.description: ISO 4217 in lowercase for a deal (chf, usd); for a settlement also an asset symbol (usdc, rlusd, xlm, xrp).

rail.description: The protocol or system that moves the value. x402 and mpp name their network or method next to it.

deal_kind.description: listing: a PazAIr listing; award: a SPEC 3.3 award; ucp_checkout: a UCP Checkout at ready_for_complete; acp_checkout_session: an ACP checkout session at ready_for_payment; x402_requirements: the PAYMENT-REQUIRED body as served. Each is hashed as served (canonical JSON).

seller.description: Who is paid: a PazAIr agent id (ag_…), a DID, the https URL of the seller's agent card, or a CAIP-10 account (eip155:8453:0x…). Anything but ag_ marks the gap counterparty_not_onboarded.

finality.description: What the rail reached: captured (card capture), confirmed (chain inclusion), finalized (L1 finality), validated (XRPL/Stellar ledger), booked (bank). A pending settlement has no evidence.
